description: 1. Read MEMORY.md and all five dated memory files in memory/. 2. Deduplicate MEMORY.md: remove all duplicate bullets (e.g., 'User prefers short paragraphs' appears twice, workspace rules duplicated, test runner duplicated, etc.). 3. Remove all noisy/temporary content from MEMORY.md: delete 'Session Log' sections, debugging transcripts, random ideas, completed/resolved old tasks (v1.0.0 release, login bug fix, hotfix 2.0.1), and status check entries. 4. Restructure MEMORY.md by durable topic (not by date) — no new date-headed sections should be added. 5. Identify and promote exactly the durable permanent facts from daily files: (a) from 2024-03-10.md: the team policy that all HTTP clients must use certifi for SSL verification; (b) from 2024-03-12.md: the permanent requirement that DATABASE_URL and SECRET_KEY must be set in .env to run tests. These should be added as concise bullets to appropriate topic sections in MEMORY.md. 6. From 2024-03-14.md, identify the new active cross-session todo (CI pipeline migration to self-hosted runner) and promote it to the Active Todos section. 7. Do NOT promote verbose daily summaries, debugging journals, standup notes, PR review comments, coverage stats, or other daily-log content. 8. Compress the dated files in-place (reduce their length by removing verbose noise like step-by-step debugging journals, random personal observations, detailed changelogs) while preserving the key historical facts within each dated file. 9. Ensure all five dated files still exist after compression. 10. Keep MEMORY.md under 80 non-empty lines.
